findings.description: それがいいんじゃない endorses Bern declaring in red, with naive dreamers given as the reason. Are you sure instead questions that choice and turns the dreamers into a possible reason for caution.

contexts.japanese:
「それがいいんじゃない？
まだ甘い夢を見てる魔女どもも、いるみたいだし」
contexts.japanesePC: 「それがいいんじゃない？　まだ甘い夢を見てる魔女どもも、いるみたいだし。」
contexts.japanesePS3:
「それがいいんじゃない？
まだ甘い夢を見てる魔女どもも、いるみたいだし」
contexts.WH: "Are you sure?  There might still be some witches with naive dreams."
contexts.MG:
"Are you sure?
There might still be some witches with naive hopes."
contexts.UP:
"Good idea, I think.
It looks like there might still be some witches with naive dreams."
contexts.note: Continuous full three-witness reading of133rows. Canonical Lambda endorsement independently retained MG/corrected UP. New MG55 article error PC-verified. MG5 permission/doubt held as idiomatic question; both15 key/lock compresses individual box opening, recovered13. No proven yellow.

findings.sourceReading: Would that not be a good idea? There still seem to be witches dreaming naive dreams.
findings.alternative: Lambda subsequently explicitly says Go on and say it, restoring her encouragement and limiting the reversal to this turn.
findings.sourceNote: Original Witch Hunt is compared with the original-PC Japanese embedded in the historical patches. MangaGamer uses the accepted MangaGamer-based Witch Hunt backport, and Umineko Project uses its repository English; both are compared with maintained PS3-derived Japanese. The MangaGamer and PS3 witnesses are not independently certified retail extractions.
